transitions.name: Powered, cooled floor space
transitions.needs: Grid interconnection, liquid-cooling-ready halls, 100kW+ rack density, permits; lead time is now measured in years

transitions.name: Design to silicon
transitions.needs: Leading-edge node capacity, CoWoS-class packaging allocation, HBM supply; capacity is booked years ahead

transitions.name: Chip to rack
transitions.needs: Reference designs, scale-up interconnect (NVLink/UALink), power delivery, OCP-style rack standards

transitions.name: Rack to rentable cluster
transitions.needs: DC capacity, capital (GPU-backed debt), cluster bring-up, orchestration, SLAs

transitions.name: Compute to trained model
transitions.needs: Distributed training stack, data, research talent, multi-thousand-GPU clusters, failure tolerance

transitions.name: Data to model
transitions.needs: Licensing rights, quality filters, expert-data pipelines, RL environments

transitions.name: Weights to tokens
transitions.needs: Serving engine, quantisation, model licence terms, autoscaling, GPU capacity

transitions.name: Tokens to building blocks
transitions.needs: Standard APIs (OpenAI-compatible), tool-calling, MCP, retrieval, memory

transitions.name: Blocks to product
transitions.needs: Workflow understanding, evals, UX, distribution, unit economics where token cost is COGS

transitions.name: Product to deployment
transitions.needs: Integration with enterprise data/systems, security reviews, change management

transitions.name: Deployment to outcomes
transitions.needs: Operating-model redesign, skilling, governance, measurable ROI

transitions.name: Direct product-led adoption
transitions.needs: Self-serve onboarding, freemium, bottom-up developer and prosumer pull
